mapper.select:
SELECT rc.case_id AS caseId, rc.report_type AS reportType, rc.target_id AS targetId, rc.reported_member_id AS reportedMemberId, reported_member.nickname AS reportedMemberNickname,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_report count_report WHERE count_report.case_id = rc.case_id ) AS reporterCount,
rc.status AS status, rc.process_reason AS processReason, rc.created_at AS createdAt, rc.processed_at AS processedAt, rc.restricted_until AS restrictedUntil,
CASE WHEN rc.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN ( SELECT mfr.restriction_scope FROM member_feature_restriction mfr WHERE mfr.member_id = rc.reported_member_id AND mfr.restricted_until <=> rc.restricted_until ORDER BY mfr.restriction_scope LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS restrictionScope
FROM report_case rc
JOIN members reported_member ON reported_member.member_id = rc.reported_member_id
ORDER BY rc.created_at DESC, rc.case_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_case rc
JOIN members reported_member ON reported_member.member_id = rc.reported_member_id

SELECT rc.case_id AS caseId, rc.report_type AS reportType, rc.target_id AS targetId, rc.reported_member_id AS reportedMemberId, reported_member.nickname AS reportedMemberNickname,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_report count_report WHERE count_report.case_id = rc.case_id ) AS reporterCount,
rc.status AS status, rc.process_reason AS processReason, rc.created_at AS createdAt, rc.processed_at AS processedAt, rc.restricted_until AS restrictedUntil,
CASE WHEN rc.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN ( SELECT mfr.restriction_scope FROM member_feature_restriction mfr WHERE mfr.member_id = rc.reported_member_id AND mfr.restricted_until <=> rc.restricted_until ORDER BY mfr.restriction_scope LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS restrictionScope
FROM report_case rc
JOIN members reported_member ON reported_member.member_id = rc.reported_member_id
WHERE rc.case_id = #{caseId}

SELECT mr.report_id AS reportId, mr.reporter_id AS reporterId, reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, reporter.email AS reporterEmail, mr.reason AS reason, mr.reported_at AS reportedAt, mr.evidence_files AS evidenceFiles, mr.evidence_deleted_at AS evidenceDeletedAt
FROM member_report mr
JOIN members reporter ON reporter.member_id = mr.reporter_id
WHERE mr.case_id = #{caseId}
ORDER BY mr.reported_at ASC, mr.report_id ASC
SELECT rc.status, rc.report_type AS reportType, rc.target_id AS targetId FROM member_report mr JOIN report_case rc ON rc.case_id = mr.case_id WHERE mr.report_id = #{reportId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT rc.reported_member_id FROM member_report mr JOIN report_case rc ON rc.case_id = mr.case_id WHERE mr.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post p JOIN report_case rc ON rc.target_id = p.post_id AND rc.report_type = 'POST' JOIN member_report mr ON mr.case_id = rc.case_id SET p.deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE mr.report_id = #{reportId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE comment c JOIN report_case rc ON rc.target_id = c.comment_id AND rc.report_type = 'COMMENT' JOIN member_report mr ON mr.case_id = rc.case_id SET c.deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE mr.report_id = #{reportId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE report_case rc JOIN member_report mr ON mr.case_id = rc.case_id SET rc.status = #{status}, rc.process_reason = #{processReason}, rc.processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rc.restricted_until = #{restrictedUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE mr.report_id = #{reportId} AND rc.status = 'PENDING'
